title: ShapeCast3D fails to detect collision when fully penetrating or inside CSG geometry
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]

### System information

OS: Windows 11 | CPU: Intel(R) Core (TM) - x64 Architecture | GPU: Intel(R) UHD Graphics (Integrated) | Driver Version: (Latest Intel Graphics Driver) | Rendering Backend: Forward+ / Compatibility (OpenGL 3.3.0 as seen in logs)

### Issue description

The ShapeCast3D node fails to report a collision even when its shape is clearly overlapping and penetrating a StaticBody3D or CSGBox3D geometry. As shown in the attached screenshot, the debug shape remains blue (indicating no collision) despite being positioned inside the wall. I expect 'is_colliding()' to return true and 'get_collision_normal()' to provide a valid vector for penetration recovery, but it currently detects nothing.

### Steps to reproduce

Enable "Visible Collision Shapes" in the Debug menu.

Create a CSGCombiner3D node and enable "Use Collision".

Add a CSGBox3D as a child with Size: (3.0, 3.0, 3.0) and Position: (-3.124, 1.706, -3.355).

Add a ShapeCast3D node with a CapsuleShape3D assigned.

Set CapsuleShape3D properties to: Radius: 0.3, Height: 1.1, Margin: 0.0.

Set ShapeCast3D Target Position to (0, 0.001, 0).

Set ShapeCast3D Position to (-3.402, 1.537, -1.953).

Set ShapeCast3D Rotation to (-50.6, 138.1, -23.2) in degrees.

Place a Camera3D facing the capsule and run the project.

Observe that the ShapeCast3D debug color remains white (no collision detected) despite being visually embedded in the CSG geometry.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A (The issue is visible in a brand new project using standard CSG and ShapeCast3D nodes).
